identity: Immutable scoped PO ID/version/digest, actual supplier terms source/version/digest, warehouse source identity, catalog pin and line IDs. A separately stored header tracks current version; old version history is retained.
units: Explicit each/case to integer each conversions, positive quantities, minimum order quantities, currency and exact minor-unit costs. Unsupported dimensions/fractional each, unknown units, stale quotes and changed prices reject.
state_rules: Creating a draft creates no supplier-facing effect. Changes invalidate prior unused approvals and reservations. After a send attempt, preserve the original version and operation for reconciliation. Native acknowledgment and cancellation are explicit immutable observations; cancellation does not imply a payment refund or release budgets.
receipt_getter: procurementPo(k,scope,{po_id,version,expected_digest}); permission checked, immutable original terms/line costs, original source operation/native IDs, source stage/digest, per-line cancelled_quantity_base and authority_revoked. It does not own receipt counters.

tests.targeted_fault: Actual initialPurchaseOrderState invents acknowledgment; the independent creation-stage assertion detects it.
